# The Zopfli compressor the VSIX `packages` steps pin (scripts/compress-vsix.py).
# Pinned so the recompressor itself changes only in a reviewed pull request;
# Dependabot's pip entry proposes each new release (PLAN.md D6, VSIXFIT B).
# A build tool, never shipped: it rewrites each .vsix member with Zopfli
# raw-deflate streams (stored for already-brotli members) and refuses to
# pack without it rather than falling back to zlib level 9.
zopfli==0.4.3
